heroTitle: PonyLife is a coordination platform for creative assets — built to experiment with visibility, participation, and real-world outcomes through delegated commercialization rights.
heroSubtitle: Creators keep ownership. PonyLife coordinates structured promotion and participation mechanics across a shared ecosystem — without promising financial returns or guaranteed results.

cards.title: Submit a work, keep ownership
cards.text: Creators list an intangible creative asset with context and media. Ownership remains with the creator while the work enters the PonyLife ecosystem.

cards.title: Delegate limited commercialization rights
cards.text: Creators can delegate specific rights so the platform may coordinate distribution, promotion, and commercialization pathways under predefined rules.

cards.title: Participation is structured, outcomes are uncertain
cards.text: The ecosystem coordinates attention and effort through participation mechanisms. Outcomes may happen — but are not guaranteed.

cards.title: PNL supports participation and internal coordination
cards.text: The token is used to represent participation and coordination within the ecosystem. It is not equity and not a promise of financial returns.

featured.title: Featured Works
featured.subtitle: A small selection from the public catalog. Inclusion reflects participation in the PonyLife ecosystem — not endorsement, pricing, or expected outcomes.
